messages:
Ravi Kapoor: heads-up 1: we've got a subtle double-count in invoice-preview when route_priority and route_override coexist. small tenant cohort sees 1.02x tokens in preview vs ledger. looks tied to how fallback routes are recorded during enrichment.

Maya Flores: can you paste the quick diff and the query you used?

Ravi Kapoor: sure: 
```
-- preview aggregates
select tenant_id, sum(tokens) from preview.events where tenant in ('na-900','na-901') and ts > now() - interval '24 hours';
-- ledger aggregates
select tenant_id, sum(tokens) from ledger.commits where tenant in ('na-900','na-901') and ts > now() - interval '24 hours';
-- result: preview ~ 1,234,560 tokens vs ledger ~ 1,207,431 tokens
```
Suspect path: proxy attaches route_priority header for billing, then ingress enrichment applies route_override for certain feature flags and emits two partial events in the coalescer window. The preview pipeline currently counts both until dedupe runs.

Owen Hart: that aligns with a known microwindow in coalescer v2 where partial attributes can cause multi-emits when enrichment updates arrive mid-window. We tried to optimize latency by emitting early and reconciling later, but reconciliation window isn't wired into preview.

Priya Singh: UX note: customers seeing preview divergence will freak. We should show a new "stability" indicator on the preview card (Low/Medium/High) and surface the reconciliation lag. Also add copy: "Preview counts are provisional and may be reconciled within 24h."

Ravi Kapoor: engineering plan (short): 
- patch coalescer to attach a stable emit_id per logical request so later enrichment updates replace not append.
- in preview pipeline, prefer latest emit per emit_id when computing sums.
- add metric plat.preview.dup_emits and a dashboard tile per-route_priority and route_override tag.

Maya Flores: how invasive is the emit_id? do we need client changes?

Owen Hart: no client change. emit_id generated at proxy from request_id (we already propagate request_id). coalescer will set emit_id=request_id at initial emit and keep it for subsequent updates. small change but touches hot path. Performance impact should be minimal.

deploy-bot: notice: coalescer v2 deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-03-24T02:00Z.

Priya Singh: rollout UX: canary the emit_id change for 2% traffic and show the preview stability indicator in staging for that cohort. If dup_emits drops by >90% after 6h, widen. Also, add an FAQ blurb for Billing team.

Ravi Kapoor: monitoring plan: emit metric plat.preview.dup_emits with labels tenant, route_priority, route_override; build a 1h resolution dashboard tile showing emitted_tokens vs preview_tokens vs ledger_committed_tokens. alert if preview_tokens > ledger_committed_tokens by >5% for >45m.

Maya Flores: PRs? Owen do you want to open the coalescer change? I'll take the preview pipeline patch and dashboard. Priya can you draft the UX copy and release note paragraph?

Owen Hart: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/coalescer/pulls/112 (WIP) 1: adds stable emit_id and dedupe logic.

Maya Flores: I'll open preview PR after I finish local test harness. target staging deploy next Wed.

billing-bot: reminder: any "provisional" tokens must be highlighted in invoice-preview and excluded from final invoices until ledger confirmation. See billing policy BP-3. File PLAT-5620 for reconciliation flow.

Ravi Kapoor: thanks all. owners: Owen -> coalescer PR + perf check, Maya -> preview pipeline + dashboard, Priya -> UX/copy + billing FAQ. Canaries: 2% -> 10% -> 100% if metrics look good. We'll reconvene in 24h post-staging deploy. :thumbsup:
